answers.text: Quote: 'R8 dip-and-reclaim... rvol is off my menu.' Impulse and mp_state are not CAN SLIM tests. My test is C16 breakout volume: day_vol 1.14 is under 1.40, and D close_vs_swing_high_pct 8.12 is the C17 late-buy band. W is LH but HL, 14.0% under the 20-wk high: no new high out of a base (C7). The refuter declares volume unread, so my volume fact stands unanswered.

Quote: 'Far past the pivot is a leader running.' A new high is C7 and I credit it, but C17 sets the buy point: D close_vs_swing_high_pct 21.55 is past the 10% line, a hard rejection for a new buy. C16 is my test, not theirs: day_vol 1.1 under 1.40. W HH but LL is no sound base. Running leader, not a buy point.

Quote: 'Far past the pivot is the C26 signal, not a fault.' That is the refuter's canon, not mine. On mine, D close_vs_swing_high_pct 21.55 sits inside a normal pullback's range (C17), and the new high printed on day_vol 1.1 (C16 fail). No exit signal is not a buy signal.

Quote: 'Late past the pivot is strength in my position system.' Not in mine: D close_vs_swing_high_pct 7.37 is the 5.1-10% late-buy warning (C17). W and D HH/HL 9>21 I credit as base and leadership, but day_vol 1.09 under 1.40 is a hard C16 rejection the refuter does not test.

Quote: 'Structure intact on all three frames.' Agreed, and my blind vote said so: leadership and structure pass. The divergence was a weight, not my reason. The reason is C16: day_vol 1.09 under 1.40 on a new high, and D 7.37% past the swing high (C17 warning). H1 0.16 above its hourly pivot is not the daily pivot.

Quote: 'day_vol 0.86 is a weight, not my test.' It is my test: a new high on day_vol 0.86 is C25 distribution and a C16 rejection. D HH/HL 0.87 above the swing high and H1 88% of range show price, not demand. Group rank 173, fifth in Staples, fails C9. Nothing here is evidence my method weighs.

Quote: 'Distance from a long average is not a danger signal.' For me it is the rule: price 70% or more above ma_200 is C24/R7 climax, sold into, never bought. W close_vs_swing_high_pct 87.2 confirms the run. D 7.0% under the 20-day high is not a new base, and day_vol 0.81 fails C16.

Quote: 'The climax is behind it... first pullback.' A first pullback after a climax run is not a sound base: no 7-8 week base (C12), and price is still far over ma_200 (C24). Quiet volume in a pullback is C15-consistent, I grant, but there is no pivot to buy and no C16 breakout volume.

Quote: 'Quiet volume is the contraction my breakout family looks for.' Partly mine too: C15 dry-up under the pivot is a fair read of D 2.4% under the swing high. But my objection was C9: rank 87 is seventh in Industrials here, not a top-3 leader. That is not answered, and C16 volume has not printed.

Quote: 'Near the broken Creek, light volume is what a test should show.' A test is the refuter's frame; mine is the breakout day. TMO made a new high on day_vol 0.94: C16 rejection and C25 low-volume high. rs IN-LINE and rank 109, fourth in Healthcare here, fail C9/C10. Group rank is my test.

Quote: 'a normal reaction near the high in an Upward Trend.' The trend I credit: W and D HH/HL. But the move past the pivot (D 2.2% above the swing high) printed on day_vol 0.86, a C16 rejection. A reaction is not a breakout; I buy the breakout on 1.40 volume, which has not printed.

Quote: 'A flat longer stack is not my trend test.' It is mine: C12 needs a prior uptrend, and ma50 329.85 under ma100 336.1 with ret_63d -1.78 shows none. W is 3.8% under its weekly swing high, not a new high (C7). day_vol 1.02 fails C16. Short-frame HH/HL does not supply a leader's base.

Quote: 'Volume is not a gate in my canon.' It is a hard gate in mine (C16): day_vol 1.02 under 1.40. W 9>21 HH/HL on the short averages does not answer C12's prior-uptrend test on the 50/100-day. Lens warns were a weight; the volume and base tests carry the line.
